caption: The drawing depicts a wooden bureau or desk with a closed slant-front top and multiple drawers arranged in three vertical columns. The object is predominantly brown, indicating polished wood, and features ornate brass or gold-colored handles and decorative hardware on the drawers and the slanted front. The bureau has cabriole-style legs with rounded feet, and there is a carved shell motif at the center of the lower edge, directly above the legs. The side panels are plain with the exception of a brass plate on the right side. The background of the drawing is plain, with a beige or off-white color, and there are no additional objects or elements present in the composition.
title: Child's Desk
